p0.requirement: 8 training families = 4 real + 4 variant from >= 2 repositories
p0.verdict: real half MET (4/4 released, 4 repositories >= 2); variant half has 4/4 specifications but zero constructed commits, so the variant half is specification-complete and construction-pending

p1_headroom.requirement: train split of 96 families = 24 real + 40 variant
p1_headroom.assessment: 110 raw candidates against a need for 24 real families is nominal headroom of about 4.6x, but qualification is unproven for any of them: each still needs a verifier run, an actor-reachability check and a bounded test patch. Do not read 110 as 24 usable.
p1_headroom.weakest_repo: more-itertools (6 raw candidates) -- thin if it must carry a share

dev_supply.requirement: a dev split needs families whose original fix time is in 2026-01-01 .. 2026-10-04, from the dev-role repositories
dev_supply.dateutil_verdict: 0 qualified dev families. dateutil's pinned revision is dated 2024-02-29, entirely before the window, so no family in that pinned revision can be a dev family. This confirms Mika's provisional count of 0.
dev_supply.attrs_observation: attrs is the only locked dev-role repository that does yield in-window dev families. The count is thin and unverified; it is headroom evidence, not a released dev set.
dev_supply.assessment: dev family supply is thin and depends on attrs plus an alternative.

options: drop it from the dev role and let the remaining dev/ sealed-role repositories carry that split
or re-pin it to a revision inside the window and redo the per-file licence ledger AND the licence approval for the new revision
or approve the already-named alternative candidate if the custodian rules that way
